display_long_description:
Experience a historical reconstruction of the biblical Tabernacle, built with attention to the descriptions found in the Book of Exodus.

Step into a 1:1 scale environment designed for learning and immersion. Walk from the Outer Court into the Holy Place, encountering the furniture and architecture as described in the Bible.

Whether for study or reflection, this 3D journey brings the dimensions and atmosphere of the Tabernacle to life with visual clarity.

Key Features:

Historical Accuracy: Reconstructed based on the biblical record.

VR Visuals: Textures and lighting optimized for VR performance.

Focus on Learning: An educational environment for all ages.

Immersive Scale: Experience the physical size of the Tabernacle in VR.

Your Feedback is Appreciated

As a solo developer, I am working to refine this experience, and your insights are valuable to me. If you have suggestions, encounter technical issues, or would like to share your thoughts on the reconstruction, please feel free to reach out to me at: contact@andrescasaretto.ch

Your feedback helps me ensure this journey is as accurate as possible. Thank you for your download and for exploring this journey.
